summary_notes: Mid-market analytics SaaS building a conversational insights assistant + improved search/reranking for product docs. Started Hosted API for POC; now moving to Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation. Key theme from leadership: "predictable monthly spend and ability to burst for campaign spikes". Procurement timeline tight — wants signed before end of Q1. SE says initial integration low friction; Legal needs clearer SLA wording around throughput and overage handling.
requirements_summary: Workload: mix of chat + embeddings-driven search. Targets: 50ms median token latency for chat, 40-60k embeddings/week, throughput average ~40 qps with burst to 120 qps during product launches. Cost sensitivity: wants committed discount but room for short bursts. Model preferences: opt for a 7B-13B open model family (quantized) with fallback to slightly cheaper model for non-critical traffic. Routing: prefer region-aware routing (NA primary, EU for EU data residency). Must have SSO, audit logs, and KMS integration for key management.
pricing_negotiation: CinderPath ask: 12-month committed tier w/ monthly billing; baseline commit 1200k tokens/month; ramp schedule + 3 months at 60% commit
Redwood initial: offered 10% discount at 12mo commit 1.2M tokens/mo, 25% overage rate, burst pool available at x1.5 cost
CinderPath counter: requests 18% discount + defined burst bucket (200% of baseline) with predictable per-month cap; wants overage defined as per-token price not multiplier
Negotiation open points: exact burst pricing, commit ramp schedule (month-by-month or frontloaded), minimum term flexibility for first year, SLA credits tied to p95 latency
Desired ramp: Month1=60%, M2=80%, M3+=100% of committed tokens. Prefers annual commit invoice but monthly true-ups.
poc_status: Hosted API POC completed 2026-02-05. Results: latency median 65ms for short contexts, token consumption tracking validated against forecast. Team satisfied with quality; want Dedicated for isolation and cost predictability. Next: demonstrate Dedicated staging and run load test at 120 qps.
risk_assessment: Medium. Positive technical fit and exec buy-in. Main risks are procurement timing, KMS gating (security), and unclear burst/overage economics which procurement flags as financial risk. Recommended mitigation: pre-agreed burst bucket pricing and a 30-day pilot on Dedicated to validate ops before full commit.
